description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19,999, ranged. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Edgar (Poison/Fire/Lightning)] to user. Causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] if there are at least 4 VI party members, causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)] if not. Grants [Attach Poison with Stacking]/[Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Poison/Fire/Lightning.

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Edgar (Poison/Fire/Lightning)
description.text: Poison/Fire/Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Poison/Fire/Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
